label: Early original-phase input of i / n / 0 / s (positions 0-3)
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase (96.5% of mass) and only at early positions t=0..3 (~96% of mass, peak at t=2; near-zero from t>=5 and in delimiter/copy phases). Within that window it is token-selective: i (6.5x lift, 38% of mass, strongest activations e.g. k m [i]), n, 0, s; weaker graded response to f, o, a, l and other letters. Mostly on first occurrences of the token (95% of mass). Magnitude is highest for i at t=2-3. The predicate (t<=3 and in_tok in {i,n,0,s}) gets dev F1 0.63, mass recall 0.71; misses are weaker activations on other letters at early positions, false positives are mostly repeats or later salient tokens after an earlier one already fired. Does not fire on <DEL>, copy-phase steps, or late original positions.
